audience: DeFi risk managers and conservative lenders on Stellar Soroban looking to deploy capital without exposure to shared-pool
problem_statement: In pooled lending models holding massive capital like Blend ($157.16M TVL), an insolvency or liquidation event in one asset puts the entire pool at risk, forcing conservative borrowers to bear contagion risk created by other users' bad debt.
angle: Pooled lending contagion is an architectural choice rather than an inevitability; by moving to isolated credit accounts, Vanna prevents collateral cascades from threatening unrelated positions, though empirical risk performance comparisons remain limited given the sparse onchain evidence currently available.
